meta.role: Canonical design tokens for the Agent Brain web UI redesign.
meta.note: These define the NEW UI. They replace packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles (tokens.css, theme.css = the old UI). Build a fresh Tailwind v4 @theme from here, for light and dark; do not import or extend the old tokens. See docs/agent-brain-ui/tokens.md.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page background base, beneath the gradient wash.

tokens.name: bg-gradient-a
tokens.usage: Top-left radial gradient wash (blue) layered over bg-base.

tokens.name: bg-gradient-b
tokens.usage: Bottom-right radial gradient wash (violet) layered over bg-base.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default glass panel fill; sits on the gradient background with an 18px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Raised glass surface for cards that need more opacity than surface.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Highest surface: chart frames, nested rows, modal bodies. Nearly opaque.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline border on panels, cards and tree rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised border on hover and active controls.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface. Passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, subtitles.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholder hints. Use at 13px+ only; borderline 4.5:1 on surface in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent: links, focus rings, uppercase section labels, primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted accent background: active nav item, selected chip, highlighted row.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted destructive background: delete hover, blocked-row wash.

tokens.name: entity-feature
tokens.usage: Feature identity colour (violet): feature badges, tree rails, feature icons.

tokens.name: entity-phase
tokens.usage: Phase identity colour (cyan): phase badges, tree rails, phase icons.

tokens.name: entity-task
tokens.usage: Task identity colour (emerald): task badges, tree rails, task icons.

tokens.name: status-draft
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: draft / unplanned.

tokens.name: status-discovery
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: discovery / exploration.

tokens.name: status-planned
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: planned, not started.

tokens.name: status-in-progress
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: actively in progress. The single most important running state.

tokens.name: status-paused
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: paused, awaiting resume (feeds the Resume Required section).

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: completed.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: blocked. Pair with an icon — do not rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: status-canceled
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: canceled.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: waiting on a dependency.

tokens.name: status-deferred
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: deferred.

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: Lifecycle status: rejected.

tokens.name: status-started
tokens.usage: Parent-derived display status: has started children.

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: Parent-derived display status: all children closed.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap between dense rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact card inner padding; gap in stacked lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between top-level dashboard sections.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, chart frames, work-tree rows.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Top-level panels and the app shell.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for cards.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Elevation for top-level panels and modals.

tokens.name: surface-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur applied to every glass surface.
